meta.dataset_version: LFW original (lfw.tgz, figshare 5976018, sha256 055f7d9c...); pairs.txt View 2

protocol: LFW View 2, 10 folds x 600 pairs; threshold chosen on 9 folds, tested on the 10th
note_accuracy: accuracy_mean counts pairs with a failed enrolment as rejected (end-to-end, production detector thresholds); accuracy_enrolled_pairs_* excludes them and is comparable to published LFW numbers, which use pre-aligned crops.
note_far: Only 3000 impostor pairs: FAR=1e-3 rests on 3 impostor scores, so TAR@1e-3 is noisy.
